items.title: Overview
items.description: Withings for Health Assistant, the self-hosted, open-source health records platform. An OAuth2 wearable connector that pulls your Withings scale, blood-pressure monitor and activity-tracker measurements into the Biomarker Engine's telemetry store.

items.title: Connection & Authorization
items.description: Connect a Withings account through your own Withings partner app: client id, the sealed client secret, the OAuth consent round-trip, the account binding, and what Check Connection validates.

items.title: Pull (Streams, Cursors & Canonical Units)
items.description: What the connector pulls and where it lands: every measure category into the telemetry store with canonical units and a registered device — with the measure cursor, dedup and mapping-gap recording; sleep and activity are flagged as not wired.

items.title: Security
items.description: Where the OAuth credentials live (one sealed slot, instance-bound, rotatable, with maintained expiry columns), the fail-closed refresh rule, tenant isolation of pulled data, and what the connector deliberately does not do.

items.title: Troubleshooting
items.description: Diagnose a Withings integration: reconnect prompts after a revoked authorization, a pending instance that never authorizes, empty pulls, unmapped measure types, hostile-payload rejections and rate-limit backoff.
